Bound Torches

You bind the dry fibers tightly, leaving a head that will take the flame evenly.

Rules

- ID: recipe-bound-torches - Permission: Trail Workshop, Make Something Useful or Enchanting Workshop; the recipe alone grants no crafting permission - Tools: Craft tools - Materials per attempt: Suitable wood, fiber and fat, obtained in the scene or one compatible carried bundle use - Time per attempt: One hour - Result: Inventory supply, maximum d6

Roll the crafting card’s attribute. Weak raises one matching supply by 1 inventory step; Standard by 2; Strong by 3, up to the printed cap. The first step from out creates d4; later steps are d6, d8, d10, d12, d20. Check carried material supply after the attempt. No group crafting.

@UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.1d865a05af20bb01.JournalEntryPage.beba8045a91aa1d9]{Product}. This recipe can be one of the two ordinary choices granted by Trail Workshop or Ordinary Recipe Study. It is reusable and does not grant free ingredients.
